idea: Add a Lagrangian-hull rescue for every n. Compute the upper concave hull of (count, best sum) over all constructions found, for counts from n−6 to n+6. For any n strictly below the hull, try combining the two hull endpoints' layouts by placing them as scaled sub-blocks in a 2×1 or 1×2 split. Use the best sub-layouts for the rectangles via the rectangle table.
